arms.description: untransformed branch; always available and the abstention target
raw plus reviewed D2 views delivered together
sample-wise median of reviewed causal views
masks applied on train/synthetic only; filled by last observation or the reviewed D2 state-space view
each reviewed mode used constantly; one arm instance per mode
mode chosen from a causal quality state (reviewed D2 SNR estimate, missingness, OOD distance) with thresholds fit on train
as P12_IQS_THRESHOLD with a minimum dwell time against chatter
best mode per block known by construction on synthetic data; regret reference only
equal share of the total cost cap to every active branch
allocation increasing with train-estimated branch quality, zero allowed
water-filling with a discount for train-estimated redundancy between branches
unallocated budget kept when marginal utility on train is not above surrogates

abstention.rule: Routing may always abstain to the raw branch: when the information quality state is unavailable, in warm-up or outside its reviewed regime, when a branch cost cap is reached, or when the router cannot decide, the output is the raw branch and the abstention is recorded.
when: information quality state unavailable or in warm-up
quality state outside the reviewed regime of the D2 decision
a D2 view whose decision is not in {LAB_CALIBRATED, REGIME_LIMITED} with review
a branch reaches its cost cap
an input is not available at decision time
the router cannot choose a mode

branches.description: reviewed D2 operator views, each in its reviewed regime
STEP 11 redundant combinations of B0 and B1
quality state, router and allocator computation

d0_d1_inputs: C129 common dataset/variable contract (identity, source, license, semantics, unit, frequency, availability, missingness, sentinels, partitions, digest)
C132 multivariate profile and grouping (training only)
consumes.d2_use: reviewed D2 operator views as branches, and reviewed D2 SNR/noise estimates as quality-state components, each only in its reviewed regime
consumes.rule: Only D2 lab decisions LAB_CALIBRATED or REGIME_LIMITED that carry an external review record are consumed, each within its reviewed regime. NOT_IDENTIFIABLE and LAB_REJECTED are never consumed. Nothing is consumed without an external review record. If no such record exists, real-data stages are NOT_RUN and only synthetic calibration may proceed.
consumes.successor_outputs: Not consumed. Outputs of other successor designs may be bound only by a later version, after their own lab decisions and external review records exist.

controls.description: A0_RAW on the same partition, sample, regime and budget
quality state block-permuted within train before thresholds are fit
random mode sequence with the same switch rate and mode frequencies as the router
redundant views replaced by independent noise with matched marginals
router driven by a quality state independent of mode superiority (STEP 12 benchmark E)
allocation that gives the budget to a pure-noise synthetic branch

decision_vocabulary.statement: LAB_CALIBRATED, REGIME_LIMITED, NOT_IDENTIFIABLE and LAB_REJECTED are laboratory decisions only; none of them equals public eligibility, and this design never grants PUBLICLY_ELIGIBLE.

failure_region_reporting.grain: arm x synthetic benchmark x quality-state regime x corruption level x budget quantum
publish: every region whose lab decision is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE or LAB_REJECTED
every region where the raw control is not dominated
every region where the null surrogate is indistinguishable
every region where the negative-control operator is not flagged
every causality or availability audit failure
every region where abstention to raw beats routing
every region where uniform allocation is not dominated
failure_region_reporting.rule: Failure regions are published with the same grain and prominence as regions that calibrate; a summary of the best case alone is refused.

grants_nothing: This design grants nothing: no execution, no scoring, no consumption, no feature selection, no training, no GPU, no RL, no DOIN, no live or venue action, and it never grants PUBLICLY_ELIGIBLE to any variable, operator, representation, router or allocation.

hypotheses.falsified_if: no STEP_11 arm shows smaller degradation than A0_RAW
hypotheses.statement: Redundant multi-view encodings degrade less than raw under train-only corruption

hypotheses.falsified_if: every tested corruption level keeps the benefit (tested range insufficient; no universal claim)
hypotheses.statement: The benefit is not universal: some corruption level erases it

hypotheses.falsified_if: router regret is not below the best fixed mode on A and B
hypotheses.statement: On benchmarks with SNR- or missingness-dependent mode superiority (A, B) a causal router has lower regret than the best fixed mode

hypotheses.falsified_if: a gain is reported on E (router claims then NOT_IDENTIFIABLE)
hypotheses.statement: With a useless quality state (E) the router does not beat the best fixed mode

hypotheses.falsified_if: chatter not reduced, or regret higher
hypotheses.statement: Hysteresis reduces chatter (F) without raising regret above the threshold router

hypotheses.falsified_if: B13_WATERFILL efficiency is not above B13_UNIFORM
hypotheses.statement: With branches of unequal known SNR, water-filling allocation beats uniform allocation at the same total cap

hypotheses.falsified_if: a non-uniform allocation dominates on equal-quality families (estimator overfit)
hypotheses.statement: With equal branch quality, uniform allocation is not dominated

hypotheses.falsified_if: allocating to the pure-noise branch improves efficiency
hypotheses.statement: A pure-noise branch receives zero budget and the reserve is used when capacity adds no utility

partitions.rule: All fitting (cells, codebooks, templates, scales, projections, lags, thresholds, allocations) uses training data only. Calibration decides the lab decision; confirmation confirms it without refitting. No sealed period is read. No target participates in this design.
partitions.target_exception: A target may appear only in a later, separately licensed utility test and then only inside training folds; it is not part of this design.

questions.question: Does deliberate redundancy across reviewed causal views reduce degradation under train-only masking and corruption relative to raw?
Does a causal information-quality router choose among reviewed modes better than the best fixed mode, and does it abstain to raw when it should?
Under a declared cost cap per branch and in total, does non-uniform allocation beat uniform allocation, and is leaving budget unused sometimes optimal?

raw_control.rule: The raw (untransformed) branch is always kept as a control arm in every comparison of STEP 11-13, under the same partition, sample, regime and budget. No transform replaces the original data before a separate, reviewed utility test.

stopping_rules.action: real-data stages recorded NOT_RUN; only synthetic calibration may proceed
stopping_rules.condition: no D2 lab decision in {LAB_CALIBRATED, REGIME_LIMITED} with an external review record exists for the operator and regime

stopping_rules.action: arm stops before public and financial data; decision NOT_IDENTIFIABLE or LAB_REJECTED
stopping_rules.condition: an arm does not identify its known truth on the synthetic bank

stopping_rules.action: refused; a new design version is required
stopping_rules.condition: a parameter or arm not predeclared in this design is proposed after any calibration output is seen

stopping_rules.action: run recorded FAILED with reason BUDGET_EXCEEDED; no extension
stopping_rules.condition: an arm reaches a declared budget cap

stopping_rules.action: decision for that regime is REGIME_LIMITED or LAB_REJECTED, never LAB_CALIBRATED
stopping_rules.condition: a candidate does not improve on the raw control on its declared preservation metric within a regime

stopping_rules.action: whole run REFUSED and recorded; no decision is emitted
stopping_rules.condition: any read of a sealed period, a confirmation refit or a target

stopping_rules.action: recorded DEFERRED with no arm in this design
stopping_rules.condition: STEP 11 corruption-hardening of the existing feature extractor (§59) requires neural training

stopping_rules.action: routing and allocation for that regime NOT_RUN; output is the raw branch
stopping_rules.condition: fewer than two reviewed modes exist for a regime

stopping_rules.action: arm LAB_REJECTED; route to raw branch
stopping_rules.condition: the budget audit counts any violation

families: parallel branches of unequal and equal known SNR
synthetic_calibration_first.generator_bank: C128 synthetic bank: clean component, perturbation, observed series, seeds and parameters stored separately and rebuildable
synthetic_calibration_first.rule: Every arm parameter is calibrated on known-truth synthetic data and frozen before any public or financial data is read. An arm that does not identify its known truth stops at the synthetic stage.
